body:
Hey Julius,

Hope you’re doing well! Just wanted to let you know that we’ve opened up our supplier portal for the Security Awareness Training RFP. Since you mentioned your ISO 27001 certification, I thought you’d be a great fit for this. Could you please register on our portal at [https://suppliers.auriga-retail.com/register](https://suppliers.auriga-retail.com/register)? It’s super quick and gives you access to all the details for RFP-2026-118. We’re looking forward to seeing your proposal!

Best,
Markus

events.reply: Hey Markus, thanks for thinking of us, this sounds like a great fit! I've had a look at the page. 4,200 people with store staff over SMS/WhatsApp is right up our alley. Quick questions before I get our team on it: who is my day-to-day contact on your side for the RFP, and are there any scope details or Q&A sessions before the 12 Dec deadline? Also, where did we talk about our ISO 27001 certification? Just so I can place it. Cheers, Julius

body:
Hi Julius,

Thanks for your questions about RFP-2026-118. Everything you need to know about the Security Awareness Training program is on the supplier portal. You can register in just two minutes and see all the details. Let me know if you have any other questions!

Best,
Markus

events.reply: Hi Markus, thanks, the page is clear on scope. But I still need the basics before I put anyone on this on a Sunday: who exactly is my contact for the RFP (is it you, or Dr. Vogt?), is there a Q&A round or briefing before 12 Dec, and when did we talk about our ISO 27001? Short answer is fine. Then I'll get the team on the registration Monday. Cheers, Julius

body:
Hi Julius,

Thanks for following up! The contact for the RFP is me, Markus, but you can reach out to Dr. Vogt or Stefanie Auer too if you need anything specific. There’s a Q&A round on the supplier portal where you can submit any questions before November 27th. 

Did you have any other questions about the RFP?

Best,
Markus

events.reply: Hi Markus, thanks, that's what I needed. I've just registered on the portal and will get the team to prepare questions for the Q&A before 27 Nov. Cheers, Julius
